mapper.select: SELECT DATE(commit_time) AS stat_date, CASE WHEN author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(author_email)) ELSE TRIM(author_name) END AS author_key, MAX(author_name) AS author_name, COUNT(1) AS commit_count FROM review_commit_fact WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND commit_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(commit_time) >= #{beginDate} AND DATE(commit_time) <= #{endDate} AND ( (author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '') OR (author_name IS NOT NULL AND author_name != '') ) GROUP BY DATE(commit_time), CASE WHEN author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(author_email)) ELSE TRIM(author_name) END

mapper.sql: CASE WHEN author_email IS NOT NULL AND author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(author_email)) ELSE TRIM(author_name) END
mapper.select: SELECT f.author_email AS author_email, f.author_name AS author_name, CASE WHEN f.author_email IS NOT NULL AND f.author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(f.author_email)) ELSE TRIM(f.author_name) END AS author_key, f.message_first_line AS message_first_line, f.commit_time AS commit_time, IFNULL(p.project_name, CONCAT(IFNULL(p.repository_owner, ''), '/', IFNULL(p.repository_name, ''))) AS project_name FROM review_commit_fact f LEFT JOIN review_project p ON p.project_id = f.project_id WHERE ( CASE WHEN f.author_email IS NOT NULL AND f.author_email != '' THEN LOWER(TRIM(f.author_email)) ELSE TRIM(f.author_name) END ) = #{authorKey} ORDER BY f.commit_time DESC LIMIT 1
